meta.title: Tour request — {tour}
meta.description: Send a request for {tour} — our manager will get back to you about dates, price and itinerary.

h1: Send a request for this tour
lead: This tour is arranged on request. Leave your details — during working hours we reply within an hour about dates, price and itinerary.

form.title: Request details
form.required: Fields marked with an asterisk are required.
form.name: Your name
form.commentPlaceholder: Hotel level, children's ages, special wishes…
form.consent: I consent to my personal data being processed to review this request — <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
form.note: We reply within an hour during working hours

errors.name: Enter your name (at least 2 letters)
errors.phone: The phone number must contain at least 9 digits
errors.email: The email address is not valid
errors.date: The date text is too long
errors.travelers: The number of travellers must be between 1 and 50
errors.budget: The budget text is too long
errors.comment: The comment is too long (1000 characters max)
errors.consent: Please give your consent to continue
errors.invalid: Some fields are filled in incorrectly. Please check and send again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.server: We could not send your request. Please try again later or call us.
errors.network: No internet connection or the server did not respond. Please try again.

success.title: Your request has been received
success.text: The request has been passed to the specialist in charge. During working hours we will contact you within an hour.

tour.days: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} / {nights, plural, one {# night} other {# nights}}
